title: Anything to add; never wrote music
summary: Asked for a favorite piece or compositions, he says he never wrote any.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: So I like your style better than that, and I think most people do. Well, I don't want to bother you any longer, but unless you can think of something else to add that you'd like to say.
I can't think of anything more.
Were there any favorite pieces you ever had, or did you ever write any numbers yourself? I might ask that.
No, no, no, I never did the, never did the writing numbers.
